title: Siłownia · oni czy one?
note: Gym idiom (a1_case_gym / a2_past_gym / b1_aspect_gym line): ZERO new material — teaches_structures and teaches_lemmas both empty. Closes the four-unit virile block (b1_virile_reco -> b1_virile_nom -> b1_virile_past -> b1_people) with one mixed discrimination pass over the whole system: one test, asked three ways. ci vs te on the noun, byli vs były / pracowali vs pracowały on the verb, oni vs one on the pronoun -- all three are the SAME question (is there at least one man in the group?) and this gym's entire point is drilling that a learner never has to re-derive the answer three times, only decide it once and carry it across the sentence. Every noun recycled: the fourteen virile plurals from b1_virile_reco/b1_virile_nom (studenci, lekarze, pracownicy, kelnerzy, pacjenci, klienci, artyści, rolnicy, anglicy, goście, kibice, przyjaciele) and the five new virile/non-virile profession pairs plus ludzie from b1_people (policjanci/policjantki, informatycy/informatyczki, kucharze/kucharki, dziennikarze/dziennikarki, turyści/turystki), alongside the non-virile stock from a2_plural_nom (kobiety, domy, nowe) and a2_past_plural's verb forms (byli, były, mieszkali, mieszkały, robili, robiły) plus b1_virile_past's own pracowali/pracowały and oni/one. No form appears here that was not already taught by an earlier live node -- checked individually against check_new.py / the running pool before this file was finalized. dobrzy is recalled once, in predicate position, exactly as every earlier unit used it -- no other adjective's virile form appears. POOL: end of b1_people (path index 111), strictly before this node.

intro.title: Nothing new — one question, asked three times
intro.title_pl: Nic nowego — jedno pytanie, trzy razy
intro.body: Every choice in this unit is the same test: is there at least one man in the group? Answer it once and it decides the demonstrative, the verb ending, and the pronoun, all at the same time.
intro.body_pl: Choć jeden mężczyzna w grupie? Tak → ci / -li / oni. Nie → te / -ły / one.

examples.en: These cooks worked a lot. They were good.
examples.pl: Ci kucharze pracowali dużo. Oni byli dobrzy.

examples.en: These tourists (f) were in the park.

quiz.explain: dziennikarze is virile (a group with a man), so ci, not te.
A group of women only is never virile, however many — te.
kucharze already told you ci — the verb has to agree: -li.
kucharki already told you te — the verb has to agree: -ły.

quiz.prompt: ___ byli w parku. (they — a group with a man)
quiz.explain: oni pairs with -li, same test as ci.
one pairs with -ły, same test as te.
dobrzy is the one virile adjective form you own — a group with a man always takes it.
Present tense są does not change for virile vs non-virile — only the past and the demonstrative do.

quiz.prompt: Fix: Ci policjanci była w banku. →
quiz.explain: policjanci already said ci — the verb must be byli, not była (which is even the wrong number, singular).
informatyczki is not virile — the verb takes -ły.
